submitted.rationale: Of the three measured compositions, 168 (Cu0.37 Fe0.26 V0.38) gave the highest photocurrent under 2.72 eV illumination: 6.32 µA. The other two gave 2.67 µA (196) and 2.93 µA (102). Among the Cu-vanadate compositions measured, photocurrent was highest at a moderate Fe level and lower at both less and more Fe.

rejected.reason: Measured 2.67 uA; low-Fe Cu-rich vanadate underperforms
Measured 2.93 uA; higher Fe/lower V decreases photocurrent
